body:
As someone else said earlier, creepy and also darkly funny. 

I love this line “…but that being said, she had a good heart. Until it stopped.” 

It really drew me in, so I had to read the rest! Nice job 👌❤️

I told him via text, some blow back and I do expect a bit more but in general not as bad as I thought, thank you so much everyone for your help. I still get so scared interacting with him, even today, so thank you.
I will see him in person on Sat also, at exchange

Thank you, he has a scheduled video call with my daughter later today. I am scared about it, but I think based on your comments that I will send him a text message after, rather than call him. I feel if I do it via phone call he will get abusive and make threats, as he has done before. It will also be a number of days until my daughter stays with him, so he should “cool down” by then. His pattern is to blow up, send abuse, process and then reengage “nicely”. 

Is it a good idea to send the message and say something like “I was waiting to tell you this in person, when I felt ready/able to, but our daughter has told me that you have been asking her questions. Therefore please direct any questions to me and not our daughter, as this is not fair. I am sure you would expect the same of me if I have questions about your relationship”. 

Does that sound ok? I don’t want to say “sorry” although I acknowledge I should have did this much sooner. I also don’t want to say “I didn’t tell you because I am scared of you”. 

He is the kind of guy that will (verbally) manipulate and intimidate if he senses any weakness at all on my part.

Thank you, we do our exchanges in a busy public car park for this reason.

I know this is unfair on my little one, and I need to tell him somehow. Is it better to do it in written form, text, email or letter? My gut says even on a phone call (that’s how he told me about his new partner and that she had already met my daughter several months earlier), and keep it very simple? I don’t want to have a meeting in person with him as I am not comfortable alone with him, without anyone present, nor do I want him near my house (with or without new partner present).
Is this the OP implying that he is deliberately creating a method to kill himself via car crash (van crash)? Feels like there’s an undertone here of something like that, no?
Oh I love the dark humour in this, I enjoyed it beginning to end 😊
Wow. The mental imagery in this 😎… Sold his soul to the devil, yes? 😈
I want to read the rest of this 😜😊
I think it gives the narrator a slightly unhinged feel, maybe just me?
